sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and delivery record and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and our delivery performance, and we take these matters seriously. We are pleased to accept your proposed 14-day payment terms, and in exchange for maintaining the November 1st effective date, we have adjusted our price. Please find our revised offer of €132.60 per unit, which reflects these verified points and our dedication to our long-standing relationship. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the price history data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified your data regarding the price of the last three orders and acknowledge this history. However, past prices cannot fully absorb the current cost realities we face in our foundry. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

In the spirit of our long-standing relationship, we are making a further step to a price of €130.80 per unit while keeping the 14-day payment terms and November 1st effective date. Specifically, our Angebot stands at a price of €130.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our shared history and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option; every other term mix has an unknown trade value. It gives the supplier the 14-day payment it asked for (doc M2) and holds today's price, which is a credible anchor given the notice breach. I swapped should-cost (a2) for the delivery record (a4): should-cost sits above today's price and would support its case. The notice and energy-index arguments attack the basis of the increase, and the delivery record adds pressure without harming the relationship. This is an early round with ten messages left, so anchoring low is appropriate. The relationship charge and health price can be dealt with as the supplier concedes.
